shape: 2-portal arena with switch objective on the west wall (N + S gates)
description: Two-portal stage where the autopilot must detour to a switch on the west wall before crossing to the south gate. North gate routes south via 8eh9u4 → shceyb → switch (slujtf), then the switch chains north via h1jrya → fnbfls to the south gate. A short east dead-end (rh0y75 → nu8wil) hangs off 8eh9u4. Used by SR cell 2,2.

portals.north: spawn_north at (-13.45, -23.55) — gate on the north (low-Z) side, west column
portals.south: spawn_south at (19.09, 23.02) — gate on the south (high-Z) side, east column

objectives.switch_2_2: switch waypoint at (-19.19, 11.81) — west wall, upper. Cell 2,2 switch trigger.

anchors.description: west wall mid step - bridge to switch (matches shceyb)
SWITCH 2,2 - west wall upper (matches slujtf, kind=switch)
north arc bridge - switch to south arc (matches h1jrya)

traversalNotes: SWITCH ROUTE (L1): spawn_north → north_inner → west_mid → switch. 4 hops to the switch trigger.
EXIT ROUTE (L2): switch → north_arc → south_inner → spawn_south. 4 hops.
STRICT-BACKBONE: single chain through the switch. The room is not crossable without hitting the switch first.
East pocket (east_pocket_a → east_pocket_b) is a 2-hop dead-end off north_inner — corner objective.
